context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rTriple Triad is a game played with special cards placed on a 3x3 board.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rEach card has 4 numbers on it, one per side.  These numbers are so-called stats.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rPlayers take turns placing cards on the board. As they do so, they try to capture and gain control of their opponent's cards.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rThat's where the numbers come in. If a player places a card with a higher number next to a card with a lower number, the player captures that card.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rThus, the goal of the game is to gain control of more cards than the other player by the end of the game.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rThere are a number of optional game rules you can apply to individual games.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rThey can affect card stats, how cards capture each other, the scoring and the prizes.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rWhen you win a game, you will recive 1 random card from your opponent from their Deck.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rThis also works the other way around: if you lose, you have to give your opponent one of your cards, chosen at random.

context: Map 13 (Game Corner), event 22, page 1: Show Text
english: \rYou can change what you win or lose from a game by using an optional game rule.
